notes.title: OBSCURIA IS NOW FREE!!!
notes.notes:
[b]Play Obscuria completely free[/b]
A psychological horror adventure that arises on a cruise ship.
Your goal?
You immerse yourself in the role of a secret police agent who has received the mission to investigate a cruise ship that has been evacuated after an order from the captain, your mission is to find the captain who is the only one missing, but be careful! Many of the passengers in the evacuation reported paranormal events. Good Luck!

-In addition to lighting failures
-Bug in the button menu

notes.title: VERSION 1.1
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.1 PATCH NOTES:
-SOUND FIXES IN SETTINGS
-HELP THE PLAYER FOR SOME PUZZLE
-OPTIMIZATION IMPROVEMENT
-FIXED THE BUG THAT AVOID YOUR ELIMINATION AND WOULD NOT DIE IN A PART OF THE GAME
-THE CART DOES NOT DISAPPEAR SUDDENLY
MORE LIGHTING IN THE PLAYER'S FLASHLIGHT
-SOME PUZZLE HAS BEEN MADE EASIER DUE TO THE COMPLICATIONS WE HAVE RECEIVED ABOUT CERTAIN PUZZLE.

DO NOT HESITATE TO NOTIFY IF YOU FIND ANY BUG

notes.title: BUGS AND OPTIMIZATION
notes.notes:
We are aware that currently in version 1.0 of Obscuria there are a few bugs, such as: Not being able to apply changes to the menu, not dying in a specific part of the game and finally an error with the save system that makes music play when do not touch.
In addition, we want to improve the performance of the game to make it more accessible to everyone.
In a few days we will make a patch to fix things and improve things in the game.
